description: This PHP class defines an AWS IAM client with methods for managing AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) services. It includes method annotations for various IAM operations, enabling interaction with AWS by invoking methods like createUser, deleteRole, getPolicy, etc.

classes.name: IamClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS IAM service, extending AwsClient

methods.name: addClientIDToOpenIDConnectProvider
methods.description: Adds a client ID to an OpenID Connect provider

methods.name: addRoleToInstanceProfile
methods.description: Adds a role to an instance profile

methods.name: addUserToGroup
methods.description: Adds an IAM user to an IAM group

methods.name: attachGroupPolicy
methods.description: Attaches a managed policy to an IAM group

methods.name: createAccessKey
methods.description: Creates a new AWS access key for an IAM user

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specified managed policy
